impact: A path back for Huang would likely lift NVDA and the AI complex (NBIS, MU, DRAM, SNXX), while a firm board rejection keeps the leadership overhang that has driven November's selloff.
summary: In his first statement since resigning, Jensen Huang said he would be honored to return as Nvidia CEO if the board concludes it serves shareholders, employees, the company and America, adding "I own my mistakes completely" and pledging to cooperate with the board's independent investigation. The WSJ reported the board is not considering reinstating him, and interim CEO Colette Kress told investors on the earnings call "we've got this". President Trump voiced support for a return on Monday, and a petition backing Huang has passed 180,000 signatures.
title: Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return as Nvidia CEO
